mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} THEN 1 END) AS monthOrderCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} AND status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) AS monthFinishedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} AND status = '已退款' THEN 1 END) AS monthRefundCount, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} AND status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND type <> 2 THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS monthAmount FROM orders

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(addtime,'%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(buynumber), 0) AS quantityTotal, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(total), 0), 2) AS amountTotal FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND type <> 2 AND addtime >= #{params.startDate} AND addtime < #{params.endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(addtime,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate ASC

SELECT goodname, IFNULL(SUM(buynumber), 0) AS quantityTotal FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND type <> 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} GROUP BY goodname ORDER BY quantityTotal DESC, goodname ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT goodname, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(total), 0), 2) AS amountTotal FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付','已发货','已完成') AND type <> 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(addtime, '%Y-%m') = #{params.currentMonth} GROUP BY goodname ORDER BY amountTotal DESC, goodname ASC LIMIT 5
